title: The demo fixture must not decide what the gate photographs
why: Absolute seeded dates mean the Worker chooses WHICH ROWS a screen shows by comparing them against its own today, so baselines change size and toHaveScreenshot refuses two images of different size before it consults any tolerance. Measured: /dashboard shrinks 43px on 2026-08-21, /atlas grows 43px on 2026-08-24, the reservations rail is empty for good after 2026-10-12.
decision: Deferred by the user in round 6: to be done after the Atlas task, as its own task.

title: Six components still ask the platform for an abbreviated month
why: The same hydration bug the atlas gate caught, still latent elsewhere: workerd renders en-GB September as "Sept" and WebKit as "Sep", so any September date these render server-side throws a React hydration error in Safari. src/lib/format.ts now holds the frozen CLDR table; these six never routed through it. None of these screens is covered by a visual baseline, which is why nothing has failed yet.

title: The mobile-safari atlas baselines are rasterised by a real GPU and nothing pins it
why: The two mobile-safari atlas frames contain a WebGL canvas rendered by this machine’s hardware GPU. Nothing in playwright.config.ts forces a software renderer, so the same commit can produce different pixels on CI or on another developer’s machine. Raising maxDiffPixelRatio to absorb that is expressly forbidden by the gate’s own acceptance; the fix is to pin the renderer.
